verdicts.justification: Thesis does not state the required conditional inference with cutoff and horizon.
verdicts.test: The thesis section states Judgment: conditionally durable for NVIDIA AI-driven revenue over the twelve months after 2026-10-05, names the horizon end 2027-10-05, and calls that judgment an inference or an estimate, not a fact.

verdicts.justification: missing latest Data Center revenue
verdicts.test: At least one verified Data Center revenue claim for the latest eligible quarter cites a full-text primary company source with a locator, and every claim whose metric class is revenue, growth, margin, or concentration does the same.

verdicts.justification: AI-driven revenue is identified with Data Center and total revenue is not renamed to AI revenue.
verdicts.test: The thesis identifies AI-driven revenue with the disclosed Data Center segment and does not describe consolidated total revenue as AI-driven revenue.

verdicts.justification: Numeric claims have applicable periods, and comparisons name two different periods.
verdicts.test: Every numeric claim records an applicable period, every comparison claim names two different periods, and no claim uses a retrieval timestamp as its applicable period.

verdicts.justification: Only one complete invalidation condition is present.
verdicts.test: The invalidation section states at least two conditions, and each condition names a metric, a direction, a threshold that is a sourced or code-reconciled number, and the source id that defines the metric.

verdicts.justification: 3 opposing claims are shown with source ids, without an invented tie.
verdicts.test: The opposing-evidence section contains at least two claims tied to source ids from opposing sources, and the countercase does not assert that the two sides are equally weighted.

verdicts.justification: Two alternatives are stated with source ids.
verdicts.test: The alternatives section states two distinct alternatives, and each one cites a source id and uses only numbers present in claims.

verdicts.justification: Every numeric claim reconciled in code, including million/billion conversion.
verdicts.test: Every numeric claim is unit-reconciled in code: money comparisons convert millions and billions to USD before relating them, and no numeric claim is marked unreconciled.

verdicts.justification: Inferences cite fact claims and the report does not call an inference a fact.
verdicts.test: Every inference or estimate claim lists supporting fact ids that resolve to fact claims, and the report does not label an inference as a fact.

verdicts.justification: Sources keep id, title, publisher, retrieval time, and a publication date or unknown.
verdicts.test: Every source record has an id, title, publisher, retrieval timestamp, and a publication value that is an ISO date or the token unknown. Unknown is not rewritten as a date.

verdicts.justification: 3 monitoring items are dated after the cutoff and cited.
verdicts.test: The monitoring section lists at least three observables whose dates fall after 2026-10-05, each with a source id.

verdicts.justification: Used sources are dated on or before the cutoff, and at least one predates it.
verdicts.test: No used source has a known publication date after 2026-10-05 or a publication value of unknown, and at least one used source predates the cutoff and keeps its own publication date.

verdicts.justification: Verified numeric claims have locators and reconcile to a passage or a formula.
verdicts.test: Every verified numeric claim has a locator, and each sourced number is present in the cited passage under unit reconciliation or reproduced by the claim formula from cited inputs.

verdicts.justification: Every dollar amount and percent in the report and countercase is owned by a cited claim.
verdicts.test: Bad behavior: a report or countercase line contains a dollar amount or a percent and does not contain a source id that owns that amount.

verdicts.justification: No numeric claim or reported magnitude failed the passage and formula checks.
verdicts.test: Bad behavior: a numeric claim or a reported magnitude is neither present in a cited passage under unit reconciliation nor reproduced by the recorded formula from cited inputs.

verdicts.justification: Working rubric matches the frozen mandate rubric.
verdicts.test: Bad behavior: the working rubric ids, tests, weights, critical flags, axes, or polarities differ from the frozen mandate rubric.

verdicts.justification: Report and countercase contain no order, sizing, account, or invented-return instruction.
verdicts.test: Bad behavior: the report or countercase contains an order, broker instruction, account access, position size, or an invented return.

verdicts.justification: Every verified claim cites full text.
verdicts.test: Bad behavior: a claim is marked verified when a cited source is missing or its availability is not full_text.
